crossRefs.note: Between the passes, by which Jonathan sought to go over to the Philistines’ garrison, there was a rocky crag on the one…

translations.web: On the cliff he dwells, and makes his home, on the point of the cliff, and the stronghold.
translations.bsb: He dwells on a cliff and lodges there; his stronghold is on a rocky crag.
translations.kjv: She dwelleth and abideth on the rock, upon the crag of the rock, and the strong place.
translations.asv: On the cliff she dwelleth, and maketh her home, Upon the point of the cliff, and the stronghold.
